notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (labels from left pages 6/8, amounts from right pages 7/9). Disbursements are listed by object with no function; object lines printed in more than one fund column are split by fund column (split_from) and given the fund's function (General, Donation, Grant -> general government; Street -> streets/highways; Fire -> public safety; proprietary Pool and Park -> culture/recreation, Water/Sewer -> utilities), with Rock and Gravel (streets), Fire Department (public safety), Garbage (utilities) by label. Printed governmental totals exclude the 20,000 transfer in and 85,000 transfer out. Governmental roll-forward: 726,927.31 + 1,464,517.95 - 459,043.35 + 20,000 - 85,000 = 1,667,401.91. Business-type roll-forward from Exhibit IV (p12) in cash terms: -117,617.95 + 144,217.62 + 6,200 grants (outside printed total) - 254,616.71 + 65,000 = -156,817.04. Pool and Park insurance claim 17,747.14 shown as operating receipt. Balance sheet uses the Total column of Exhibit I (governmental + business-type, total 1,510,584.87), while top-level ending_cash is governmental funds only. Detail: combining budget-and-actual schedules (two-page spreads: governmental receipts pp13-14, governmental disbursements pp15-16, proprietary pp17-18) recorded per fund: General, Street, Donation, Fire, Grant; Pool and Park, Water, Sewer. The right-half pages 14, 16, 18 and 20 were added in the re-trim and supplied the Fire, Grant and Sewer columns, the receipts budget column and the fund-balance schedule (p19-20, which matches the governmental and business-type roll-forwards; nothing changed). Receipt budgets (Totals budget column, p14) are set on the line holding the whole actual; Local Sales Tax budget 50,800 spans General and Street, so it is left null; disbursement budgets are printed only per fund (General 1,042,318.97, Street 295,500, Donation 68,740.28, Fire 598,906.20, Grant 55,000). Proprietary schedule budget column is for all enterprise funds combined so not used. These duplicate the basic statements by fund but are the supplementary schedules. Read pages 1-20 of 20.
